data.gender_notes: Karylin is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'karyo' meaning 'pure, clear', and 'linos' meaning 'one'. In Greek mythology, Karylin was an epithet given to the goddess Aphrodite, symbolizing purity and clarity. The name Karylin carries the meaning “Pure, clear one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Karylin usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, clear one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_english.meaning: Feminine name derived from American name, means sweet and lovely
in_english.long_meaning: The name Karylin is derived from the American name Karylin, which is itself derived from the name Carolus. Carolus was originally a masculine name, but in American culture it has been feminized and has become popular. Karylin is a feminine name that is used in American culture and has spiritual significance in the Christian tradition, symbolizing sweetness and loveliness.
